description: A fixed 30 dB drop on the raw envelope misreads a 50 ms release under reverb.
name: 53-drop-time

recipe.method: time from note-off until the 10 ms RMS of the raw tail first falls 30 dB below the RMS of its first 10 ms; minimum and maximum over reverbs and trials
recipe.seeds: trial i of reverb b uses seed 5390 + 100 b + i
